notes.title: King of Phoenix now has Steam Trading Cards!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34798748/76510c13b35e8ad5f077a6e06738aa8ace3721ff.gif[/img]

Hey Dawgs,

Just want to thank you all again for supporting our studio these years. We are happy to announce some great news:  

[h1]King of Phoenix now has Steam Trading Cards[/h1].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/891870/King_of_Phoenix/#:~:text=About%20This%20Game-,King%20of%20Phoenix%20is%20a%20comedic%20adult%20harem%20dating%20sim,of%20very%20lovely%20ladies%20there.

We hope you enjoy the added content. 

Uncle Ricky
